title: Elizondo confirms Hastings' UFOs and nukes reporting

tellings.quote: he's right he is legit he has his observations and and his conclusions are spoton I couldn't talk about it at the time when I was in the government uh but we everything he was reporting we saw yep it was absolutely correct

plain: Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who worked on UFO matters, says the researcher Robert Hastings was right in his reporting on UFOs showing up at American nuclear missile sites, the subject of Hastings's work UFOs and Nukes. Speaking from his own government experience, Elizondo says "everything he was reporting we saw" and calls Hastings's conclusions "spot on". He adds that he could not say so while he was still in government. If true, the military itself has watched UFOs near nuclear weapons.
